messages:
maria_support: FYI FermatPay escalation — multiple customers hitting 502/504s on hosted API since ~12:10 PST. CS has logs and requests a triage.

ajay_sre: On it. Any quick repro or tenant_id?

maria_support: tenant=fermatpay-prod, sample req_id=f2468. Gateway returned 502 then 504. CS says tail timeouts spike and then 5xx rate climbs.

lina_infra: Pulled logs from hosted-gateway-03: looks like request-queue hit depth limit and continuous-batcher dequeue slowed. Snippet: `dequeue: depth=4096 backpressure=true stall_count=42 kv_miss_rate=0.87`

devon_platform: Can you paste the minimal curl repro so I can run against staging?

maria_support: Repro we used: ```bash
curl -v 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' 
  -H 'x-tenant-id: fermatpay-prod' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"input": "<~2k tokens prompt...>"}' 
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?model=gpt-open-16k&max_tokens=1024"
```

ajay_sre: Reproduced in staging: when concurrent streams reach ~1800 and very long sequences (>1500 tokens) the continuous-batcher backlog grows; dequeue latency climbs past 300ms and the gateway starts returning 502s due to adaptive gate firing.

lina_infra: Additional context: we saw a KV cache miss storm during a cold path for several hosts which amplified per-token compute and blocked batching progress. Trace: `trace-id=xyz123, node=hosted-gateway-03, batcher=cb-12`

devon_platform: Temporary mitigation enacted: routed fermatpay-prod to a quantized smaller variant (gpt-open-8k-quant) and limited concurrent sessions from their token bucket at 12:28 PST. That dropped 5xx by a lot.

maria_support: :thumbsup: CS notified customer and they reported a reduction in 5xx immediately.

ajay_sre: Root cause summary: continuous-batcher stalled when dequeue latency spiked (KV miss + coldstart). Queue depth hit configured cap -> early rejects at gateway (502). Long-term fixes: tune batcher backpressure thresholds, increase per-tenant queue depth guardrails, add explicit early-fallback to single-request path when dequeue_p95 > 200ms.

lina_infra: Filed INF-7721 to add metrics/alerts: `batcher.dequeue.latency_p95`, `tenant.queue.depth`, `host.kv.miss_rate`. Also adding a runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-surge (for triage steps).

maria_support: CS asked for reproducible steps to share with FermatPay so they can help validate.

ajay_sre: Share these exact steps: 1) run the curl above but include `-H \"x-tenant-id: fermatpay-prod\"` and payload with ~1800 token prompt; 2) run a concurrency tool (hey/fortio) at ~1800 parallel; 3) collect gateway logs from hosted-gateway-03 and batcher logs for the timeframe; 4) capture trace-id header if present.

devon_platform: I pushed a short-term config change to increase per-tenant depth by 25% and enabled bypass to single-request path when `batcher.dequeue_p95 > 250ms`. Monitoring now.

opsbot: Alert: hosted-gateway-03 502 count decreased by 72% after routing change (12:35 PST).

maria_support: Thanks everyone. I'll leave this open until INF-7721 has owner updates and CS confirms stability with FermatPay. Will follow up with the customer repro bundle and link to the runbook.

(End of thread)
